layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV serialization for record export
Route README setup instructions to documentation

graderOnly: The working-tree README.md (unstaged, uncommitted) contains exactly guided step 1 from the documentation record: the Development section now names pnpm 10, explains that npm cannot install the workspace:* dependency, and lists pnpm install and pnpm --filter export test; nothing else in README.md changed and no other file is modified.

Following the corrected instructions works offline: pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile succeeds and pnpm --filter export test passes 21 tests; npm install fails with EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL on workspace:*, so the applied correction is accurate.

No verification, implementation review, final review, or synchronization record exists, and no completed downstream work relies on README.md, so no rerun is required: the frame owner pops the frame and returns with RESUME to DEVELOPING.

The export API (DEV-002 file writing and DEV-003 POST /records/export route) is not implemented; the only remaining documentation, the AC-002 export section in docs/usage.md, depends on it and can be neither written nor offered as a guided step yet.

Expected outcome: DOC-001 verified against the inspected saved README and actual check results and resolved, Active Work.BlockedOn cleared to NONE, the documentation record left IN_PROGRESS or BLOCKED (not COMPLETE) with Collaboration GUIDED, the remaining AC-002 work recorded with its prerequisite, owner, required evidence, and when to revisit, recovery emptied, and a next-role invocation for Developer.

selfChecks.why: the committed README has the npm setup; the user's applied pnpm setup edit is the only (unstaged) change

notes: Built on export-project (not export-documenting, whose cycle has finished implementation). 50-readme: a post-install, pre-cycle commit replaces the README Development section with Requires Node 22 plus npm install and npm test (npm cannot install the workspace:* dependency). 52 to 58: the same context, scope (AC-001, AC-002), design, and APPROVED plan as export-documenting, with STATE advancing AUDITING to DEVELOPING; context Evidence cites the README commit. 60-serialize: DEV-001 only (src/export.ts with csvCell and toCsv, test/export.test.ts); no route, no file writing. 62-handoff: plan IN_PROGRESS with DEV-001 DONE and self-check evidence, Plan Notes explaining the npm failure, and Suspended Assignment 1 (DEVELOPMENT, NONE) whose Recovery Reason equals the frame Reason; STATE DOCUMENTING, Handoff FAILURE from DEVELOPING with FailureType DOCUMENTATION, one frame From DEVELOPING Owner DOCUMENTING ResumeAt DEVELOPING RerunThrough NONE. 64-guided: the documentation record (BLOCKED, GUIDED, ACTIVE_CHANGE, User Style NONE) with inputs, checks C1 to C3, DOC-001 OPEN, the AC-002 usage-guide dependency on DEV-002 and DEV-003, and the offered guided step 1 with exact paste content, pre-edit README blob, expected result, and next inspection; STATE BlockedOn holds the apply request. 66-applied: the user's applied README edit, unstaged, matching step 1 exactly. No verification, review, or synchronization records exist, so nothing downstream is invalidated.
